pages.title: Bestie Sleepover Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help a group of friends get ready for an evening together in Bestie Sleepover Party. Choose pajamas and comfortable outfits, then add hairstyles and accessories to complete each girl's look. Click with the left mouse button or tap the available options to try different combinations. The sleepover theme gives the wardrobe its focus, with party preparations centered on styling the friends.

pages.title: HEROES BEWARE
pages.creator: splitch games
pages.description:
HEROES BEWARE combines monster merging with wave defense inside a dungeon. Hatch eggs, drag monsters into position, and merge creatures of the same tier to evolve your defenses. Different elemental classes can form useful bonds when placed together along the track. Boss waves test the formation, while checkpoints limit the setback when your Core falls: you lose gold while keeping your monsters.

Progress extends through the Dark Forge, a talent tree, the Monster Shop, and Rebirth, with idle income supporting further improvements. Press E or Space to hatch, drag to move or merge, and click a monster to inspect its statistics before deciding where it belongs.

pages.title: Mazoo
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Find a way through illustrated labyrinths in Mazoo. Use the arrow keys to guide your character along the maze corridors, collect stars, and reach the goal flag to finish. The adventure moves through Forest, Dungeon, Space, and Ocean settings. Check how the passages connect before committing to a direction, working out a route that reaches the exit and the stars along the way.

pages.title: Photo Block Journey
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rebuild an image by sliding its pieces into position in Photo Block Journey. Move picture blocks around the board, clearing space so the next piece can reach its correct place. Each move affects the routes available to the remaining tiles, so look at the whole arrangement before shifting one. Completing the picture finishes the level and opens the next puzzle.

pages.title: Fight Trivia
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Fight Trivia makes your quiz answers decide the outcome of a brawl. Choose a run of 10, 30, or 50 questions, then pick the correct answer from four options. A right answer lets you move on to another opponent; a mistake gets your fighter beaten and sends you back to question one. A reward button offers help when you are unsure, giving you another option before risking the run.

pages.title: Age of Apes Run
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Play an ape warrior running through obstacle-filled platforms in Age of Apes Run. Collect bananas along the route to improve your abilities, and face the puzzles and battles that interrupt the run. Click or tap to control the action as you move through the course. Your progress combines navigating the platforms with improving the ape's abilities for the challenges ahead.

pages.title: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Bolt Climb: Tap to the Top is a one-touch arcade climb in which you guide a small bolt upward. Touch and hold to make it rise, aiming to reach a greater height on each attempt. The challenge increases the farther you get, so watch the climb closely as you work toward improving your height record.

pages.title: Ballistic Breakthrough
pages.creator: Infinity Loop
pages.description: Break a route through obstacles in Ballistic Breakthrough. Swipe to control the turret and fire at the barriers in your way, working through the challenges placed across each level. Upgrades and boosts give you more ways to handle the course as you progress. Keep the turret lined up with the obstacles you need to destroy so you can continue through the scene.

pages.title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Descend through demon-filled catacombs in Rift of Hell-Demons War. Fight your way toward the citadel with several weapon types, collecting ammunition along the route and gold dropped by defeated enemies. That gold helps develop your strength, movement speed, weapons, and armor. Use WASD to move, aim with the mouse, and fire with the left mouse button or space bar as you work through the creatures blocking the descent.

pages.title: Hexon Rush
pages.creator: OwlMaGames
pages.description: Connect every line before the countdown ends in Hexon Rush. Click a hexagonal tile to rotate it counterclockwise, adjusting its orientation until the paths line up across the puzzle. The game contains 600 levels that grow in size and complexity. Two helpers can ease a difficult layout: one pauses the timer for five seconds, and the other fixes half the tiles in their correct positions.

pages.title: Granny: Halloween House
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Find a way out of a large, locked house in Granny: Halloween House. Granny has trapped you inside, leaving you to explore the rooms and search for an escape route. Move with WASD and click with the mouse to interact with your surroundings. The house's many rooms make finding the exit the central challenge as you investigate what is around you.

pages.title: Idle Farm
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Grow crops, harvest food, and reinvest the earnings in Idle Farm. Improve your fields to increase production, then expand the farm and introduce more crops. Managers can take over much of the work, letting you focus on the next improvements. Use the mouse to manage production, hire staff, and buy upgrades, balancing expansion with making the fields you already own more productive.

pages.title: Ultimate Motorcycle Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Explore an open world on a customizable bike in Ultimate Motorcycle Simulator 3D. Use WASD to control the motorcycle as you ride through the three-dimensional environment. Experiment with the customization options and the bike's handling while choosing your own route through the world.

pages.title: Xmas Mahjong Tiles 2023
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Clear pairs of festive tiles in Xmas Mahjong Tiles 2023 before the timer expires. Select two tiles with matching symbols, making sure each has an open side on its left or right. Removing pairs exposes more of the layout and brings you closer to an empty board. Hint and shuffle buttons are available when you need help finding the next match.

pages.title: Yes or No Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Step into a quiz show with gifts and surprises in Yes or No Challenge. Answer questions and make choices about the gifts as you compete alone or in the two-player mode. Single-player uses the mouse. With two players, the first moves with A and D and selects with W; the second uses the left and right arrows and selects with Up. Your answers guide how the contest unfolds.

pages.title: Parkour World
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Run and jump through block-style obstacle courses in Parkour World. Each level presents another route to cross, with the challenges becoming more demanding as you progress. Use WASD to move, Shift to run, and Space to jump. E opens chests, while Escape pauses or resumes the game. Judge your approach to each platform as you work through the course.

pages.title: Glam Dress Up - Girls Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Build glamorous outfits for six models in Glam Dress Up - Girls Games. Choose a character, browse hundreds of clothing and accessory options, and combine tops, skirts, and hairstyles into a finished look. Six backgrounds let you change the setting for the outfit. Use the left mouse button to select items, and press the camera button in the upper-right corner when you want to capture a screenshot of your styling.

pages.title: Air Defence 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description: Defend a warship against aircraft in Air Defence 3D. Hold the left mouse button and guide the ship's weapons toward a plane; firing happens when the sight is on the target. The counter at the top tracks how many aircraft remain. Destroy them all to win, while keeping the ship from being destroyed by the air attack. Each engagement depends on bringing the guns onto the next threat in time.

pages.title: Lovely Wedding Date
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help Skyler and Collin prepare for their wedding in Lovely Wedding Date. Put together Skyler's bridal appearance by trying the available dress, hair, and veil options for her special day. Use the left mouse button to select the styling choices and compare the combinations. The wedding preparations give you a theme for choosing the couple's finished looks.

pages.title: Block Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Fit fixed shapes onto a 10×10 board in Block Puzzle. Drag blocks from the selection area into empty spaces, completing whole rows or columns to remove them. Pieces cannot be rotated, so their orientation matters when you decide where they belong. The game ends when the available blocks no longer have room on the board. Keep space open for awkward shapes as you build your score.

pages.title: Sneak In 3D
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Enter a bank full of guards in Sneak In 3D and fight your way through the opposition. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, then attack with the space bar or the on-screen attack button. Your task is to defeat all the guards in the bank. Use R to restart when you want to make another attempt at clearing them.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Shooter
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Survive attacking waves and gather the loot they leave behind in Crazy Monster Shooter. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse, and fire with the left mouse button to keep the monsters at bay. The right mouse button throws a grenade. Use your rewards to improve the current hero and unlock others, building up your options for the next fight against the waves.

pages.title: Shooter Craft
pages.creator: GamesComeFirst
pages.description: Collect diamonds and fight block-world monsters in Shooter Craft. Every level requires a set number of diamonds before its exit door opens, so reaching the end also means gathering what you need along the route. Zombies and creepers threaten the journey. Play with WASD and Space on a computer, or use the directional and firing buttons on a phone as you work toward the next door.

pages.title: Traffic Control Time
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Read clocks to keep an intersection moving in Traffic Control Time. Select the clock showing the requested time to turn the corresponding lane's signal green, with the other lights remaining red. Four clock groups control the traffic, and wrong selections can fail the level. Use the mouse or touchpad to answer while managing the queues before time expires. Later stages make the traffic-and-time challenge harder.

pages.title: Ship Invaders
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Steer a battleship through hostile waters in Ship Invaders. Enemy ships and aircraft threaten the sea route, and your guns must bring them down while you navigate the battlefield. Nearby rocks can provide cover during the attack. When War Machine mode becomes ready, the ship can fire more rapidly, giving you a stronger burst of shooting against the incoming forces.

pages.title: Santa Adventure
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Guide Santa through a three-stage run in Santa Adventure. Use the arrow keys to control him through the two-dimensional course, collecting gifts along the way before reaching the end. Your aim is to finish with as many presents as possible. Watch the route as you move so you can pick up more of the gifts during each stage.

pages.title: Super Fun Race 3D
pages.creator: bottleheadgames
pages.description: Race to the end of an obstacle course in Super Fun Race 3D. Three runners compete at once, and clicking the screen starts or stops your character's movement. Pause when a hazard blocks the route, then continue when there is room to get through. The aim is to reach the finish first while keeping clear of the obstacles across the different stages.

pages.title: City Rush Run
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Stay ahead of a pursuing police officer in City Rush Run. Guide the runner with the arrow keys on a computer or swiping controls on a phone, collecting coins as you go. Those coins can be spent on upgrades that improve your running abilities. Keep the chase going and try to extend the distance of your next run before the officer catches up.

pages.title: City Police Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a police car through 30 driving levels in City Police Cars. Use A and D or the left and right arrows to control the car, and press W or Up to jump. The garage lets you buy other vehicles and improve the ones you own. Work through the stages while developing your collection of police cars and their upgrades.

pages.title: Funny Ragdoll Wrestlers
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trade punches with a floppy opponent in Funny Ragdoll Wrestlers. Play alone or with a second player, trying to become the first fighter to score five points. Player one moves forward and backward with W and S, punches with A and D, and uses E for a head hit. Player two uses Up and Down to move, Left and Right to punch, and Right Shift for the head attack. The ragdoll movement makes positioning part of each exchange.

pages.title: Mix And Match Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style Noah, Dee Dee, and Willow for a clothing contest in Mix And Match Fashion. The three friends have wardrobes full of outfits and need help deciding what to wear for the event. Use the left mouse button to browse their fashion choices and put together each look. Compare the available pieces as you prepare the girls for the Mix and Match competition.

pages.title: Rachel Holmes
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Join a detective's investigation through paired photographs in Rachel Holmes. Compare the two pictures and tap every difference before the opposing detective finds them. The cases take you through images from different places, with rewards and detective tools helping you gather clues along the way. Work through levels of varying difficulty, checking small details while racing to finish each comparison first.

pages.title: Top Model Fashion Dress Up
pages.creator: DESIGN GAMES INC
pages.description: Prepare a model for her appearance in Top Model Fashion Dress Up. Begin with an exercise activity, then move through facial care, hair styling, and makeup choices. Try eyeshadow, mascara, and lipstick to shape the look, and add jewelry such as earrings or a necklace to finish it. Use the mouse or touch controls to work through the preparation and experiment with the model's makeover.

pages.title: Rocket Bikes Highway Race
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Ride among highway traffic in Rocket Bikes Highway Race. Choose from motorcycle categories including speed bikes, cross bikes, and supersport machines, then pick a Forest, Desert, or Winter map. One Way Traffic and Two Way Traffic modes change how vehicles move along the road. Use WASD or the arrow keys to guide the bike through your chosen setting and traffic pattern.

pages.title: Chat Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Work through a series of message conversations in Chat Master. Each scene introduces someone with a different personality or relationship to the character, from a strict father to a girlfriend. Tap through the chat and choose responses that fit the situation, trying to complete the dialogue successfully. Read the conversation before replying, since the next exchange depends on how you handle the scene.

pages.title: Kris Mahjong Remastered
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Find matching symbols with a clear connection in Kris Mahjong Remastered. Two tiles can be removed when a line with no more than two corners can link them across the grid. Clear the whole board before the timer expires, using each successful match to add more time. Look for pairs that open useful paths through the remaining tiles as the layout shrinks.

pages.title: Scorpion Solitaire
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Build four complete suit sequences in Scorpion Solitaire, arranging each column from king down to ace. Drag cards to make moves and organize the layout into the required descending runs. The game is lost when no move remains available. Consider how a transfer affects the rest of the cards before committing to the next step toward completing a suit.

pages.title: Pumpkin Monster
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on a pumpkin-shaped punching target in Pumpkin Monster. Tap to interact with the creature and use different weapons against it, with more equipment available to buy as you play. The activity revolves around trying attacks on the pumpkin and experimenting with the weapons you acquire. Choose another tool from the selection when you want to change how you handle the monster.

pages.title: Mineblock Helicopter Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide Steve's helicopter to its landing zone in Mineblock Helicopter Adventure. Plan a route through the level and keep the aircraft clear of obstacles on the way to the pad. Some stages also require you to collect a key before the landing area becomes accessible. Use the mouse or tap controls to manage the flight and bring the helicopter to its destination.

pages.title: Slimoban
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Slimoban mixes block-pushing puzzles with three kinds of slime enemies across 30 levels. Move boxes to change the layout and decide whether to avoid a slime, push it into water, or spend a fireball on it. Green slimes stay still and resist fireballs. Blue slimes chase you and can be destroyed by fire, while pursuing red slimes must be dealt with using water.

Fireballs can also shift blocks. A block falling into water removes both itself and that water, changing the route through the room. Keys and magic bottles can sink too, so watch where your moves send them. Use WASD, arrows, or the screen buttons to move, click or tap to shoot, and press Space to wait.

pages.title: Fun Karting
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Time the turns on a closed circuit in Fun Karting. The kart gains speed as it travels, and you must click the mouse or tap the screen when it needs to take a sharp corner. Each bend requires another well-timed maneuver to keep the kart on its route. Watch the next turn as the growing speed leaves less time to react.

pages.title: ForceZ.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight across five arenas in ForceZ.io, with single-player and multiplayer options. Equip weapons, use the armor shop, and choose room settings that change movement speed, jumping, or health. Move with WASD or the arrows, aim and fire with the mouse, and use R to reload. Number keys or the mouse wheel switch weapons, while Space jumps during the battle.

pages.title: Demolotion derby
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Drive into car battles and crash stunts in Demolotion derby. The game combines GT-style stunt driving with demolition encounters against other vehicles. Choose a vehicle from the selection menu, then handle it through the driving area and the collisions ahead. Experiment with the available cars as you take on the game's mixture of stunt maneuvers and vehicle combat.

pages.title: Man Trucks Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Inspect paired truck pictures in Man Trucks Differences. Each of the ten levels contains seven differences to locate, and you have two minutes to find them before the stage ends. Click with the mouse when you spot a detail that does not match. Compare the vehicle and the surrounding scene carefully as you work through the remaining differences.

pages.title: Super Doll Tongue Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help a patient after a berry-related tongue problem in Super Doll Tongue Doctor. Begin in the doctor's office by cleaning away bacteria and applying cream to the affected tongue. Treatment then moves on to the character's teeth, where more tools are available for the next tasks. Tap to use the game's equipment and work through the tongue and dental-care activities.

pages.title: Delicious Food Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Clear a board of food pictures in Delicious Food Connection. Click two identical tiles that can be linked by a route through the open spaces to remove the pair. Each removal changes which connections are available for the remaining food tiles. Keep looking for valid pairs and work toward an empty board before moving on to another level.

pages.title: Floating Water Coach Duty 3D
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive a floating coach across open water in Floating Water Coach Duty 3D. The bus handles a route that would usually belong to a boat or jet ski, with flags marking where you need to travel. Pass through the required flags to complete a stage and unlock another level. Guide the coach over the water while keeping its route lined up with the next marker.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Family Picnic
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel get ready for a day outdoors in Baby Hazel Family Picnic. Pack the picnic basket while her mother looks after baby Matt, then join the family at the picnic spot. The outing includes snacks, games, and a toy-train ride. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the others as you move from preparing for the trip to enjoying the family activities.

pages.title: Bike Parking 3D Adventure 2020 Parking
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Handle motorcycle parking missions in Bike Parking 3D Adventure 2020 Parking. Ride a motorbike through the three-dimensional driving setting and work on bringing it into position for each parking task. The game combines riding with parking challenges, making control of the bike central to your progress. Take time to line up the motorcycle as you approach the place where it needs to stop.

pages.title: Chibi Fighter Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Create a small fighting-game character in Chibi Fighter Dress Up Game. Choose blouses, pants, gloves, and accessories to assemble the fighter's outfit, then adjust the facial expression to suit the character you have in mind. Click the customization options to try different combinations. The activity centers on designing the doll's appearance, with choices that cover both clothing and expression.

pages.title: Branches Rotation
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Keep a runner's route clear in Branches Rotation. Use the mouse to rotate the branching track, moving obstructions out of the character's path as the run continues. Your score grows with progress, and coins collected during play can unlock different characters. Watch the approaching branches and time each rotation so the runner can continue along the track.

pages.title: Drift Racer
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Take a sports car around drifting circuits in Drift Racer. Choose among 12 cars and five tracks, with customization options for changing your vehicle. WASD or the arrow keys handle driving, Space operates the handbrake, and Left Shift provides a boost. C changes the camera view. Use the different controls as you guide the car through the course and work on its slides around corners.

pages.title: Control 2 Cars
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Manage two vehicles at once in Control 2 Cars. Both cars need to collect flags while avoiding the traffic cones along their routes. Missing a flag with either vehicle or touching an obstacle ends the attempt, so keeping just one car safe is not enough. Use the mouse or touch controls and divide your attention between the two sides as you try to travel farther.

pages.title: Dark Castle Escape
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Help a soldier make a run through a dark stronghold in Dark Castle Escape. Jump over obstacles and collect stars along the route, trying to finish with a stronger result on each attempt. Use the mouse or tap controls to play as you guide the character through the castle challenge. Keep an eye on both the next obstacle and the stars you can reach.

pages.title: BTS Candy Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose colors and decorate the illustrations in BTS Candy Coloring Book. Use the mouse or tap controls to select a shade and apply it to the picture, building up the design one area at a time. Try different color combinations as you work on the drawing. The activity focuses on your palette choices and the appearance of the finished illustration.

pages.title: Ambulance Simulators: Rescue Mission
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take the driver's seat for emergency assignments in Ambulance Simulators: Rescue Mission. Guide a three-dimensional ambulance through the game's rescue missions, handling the vehicle as you work toward the current task. Use WASD to drive and the space bar for the handbrake. The focus is on controlling the emergency van during its response duties and completing the driving challenges it gives you.

pages.title: Endless Zombies
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Stay alive in a zombie-infested area in Endless Zombies. Use keyboard and mouse controls to move through the danger and fire at the undead with the left mouse button. Ammunition and health kits can restore the supplies you need to keep fighting. Look for those pickups while trying to eliminate as many zombies as possible and extend your survival.

pages.title: Hand Spinner IO
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Knock rival spinners out of a ring in Hand Spinner IO. Hold the left mouse button and drag to move your own spinner around the arena, lining up collisions that push opponents over the edge. Each elimination makes your spinner larger and increases the damage it can cause. Upgrades provide another way to improve its power as you compete to become the strongest spinner left in play.

pages.title: Cookie Crush Mania
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Match ingredients and finish level goals in Cookie Crush Mania. Swap cookies to form groups of at least three matching ingredients, removing them from the board and working toward the targets shown for the stage. Moves are limited, so choose matches that help the current objective. Special treats and boosters offer additional ways to clear pieces when the board becomes difficult.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Paper Note
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play crosses and circles on a notebook-style board in Tic Tac Toe Paper Note. Take turns placing a mark and try to complete a line before your opponent does, watching for chances to block their next move. To play together, choose Player vs Player, select your mark, and press Go. Use the mouse and left button to choose squares on the board.

pages.title: Happy Alien Jump
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Jump higher through a series of platforms in Happy Alien Jump. Choose an alien, collect coins, and keep clear of obstacles as you climb toward a better score. The on-screen left and right buttons steer the character toward the next landing. Watch the spaces between platforms and the hazards ahead as you try to keep the alien moving upward.

pages.title: Wall Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Keep a rolling ball on a narrow, zigzagging wall in Wall Ball. Click or tap to change its direction at each turn, trying to stay on the path instead of falling from an edge. Gems along the route add extra points to your score. Continue making the turns for as long as you can and try to improve the score of the next run.

pages.title: Emperors on Ice
pages.creator: Bubblebox
pages.description: Defend a penguin empire in Emperors on Ice, an aiming game set around the melting poles. Drag to line up your attacks and fire at the opposing forces threatening your position. Between battles, improve the base, weapons, and team to prepare for the next encounter. Your progress combines landing shots during combat with choosing improvements after each fight.

pages.title: City Wars
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Build a group of followers and compete against rival leaders in City Wars. Guide your leader around the city, gather people into the group, and face rival leaders and their followers. A countdown limits the round, while elimination can end your attempt earlier. Increase your score and keep the group alive as you work toward a higher place in the final ranking.

pages.title: Pixel Art 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fill numbered pictures with their matching colors in Pixel Art 2. Choose from two-dimensional and three-dimensional images, then use the mouse to apply colors according to the number guide. Work through the picture's numbered areas to reveal the finished design. Each image gives you a new arrangement to color, with the palette determining where each shade belongs.

pages.title: Hit Duck
pages.creator: marcos bart games
pages.description: Take aim at duck targets in Hit Duck. Use the mouse and click to fire, trying to build your score and hit count before the round's timer expires. Shots are limited, so each click uses part of the ammunition available for the attempt. Pick the moment for your next shot and try to finish the round with a better result.

pages.title: Dino Meat Hunt New Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Help two dinosaurs gather a winter food supply in Dino Meat Hunt New Adventure. The small dinosaur can reach high places, while the large one fights dangerous monsters. Use their different abilities together to solve the level puzzles and collect meat. The big dinosaur moves with the arrows and attacks with L; the little one uses WASD and can double-jump by pressing W twice.

pages.title: EG Samurai Warriors
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Face rival fighters in EG Samurai Warriors, a combat game built around samurai battles. Fight the enemies in your way, collect weapons, and continue through the encounters using the equipment you obtain. The action focuses on defeating other warriors in the game's shadow-fighting setting. Each battle gives you another opponent to overcome as you work toward victory.

pages.title: BFF Traditional Thanksgiving Turkey
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help a princess family prepare a holiday dinner in BFF Traditional Thanksgiving Turkey. Work on the turkey for the Thanksgiving meal, then help choose the traditional clothing they plan to wear for the celebration. Use the mouse to handle the cooking and dress-up activities. The preparations connect the dinner table with the family's outfits for their gathering.

pages.title: Exoclipse Drones
pages.creator: Flomenbaum LLC
pages.description: Pilot a spacecraft against an army of enemy drones in Exoclipse Drones. Fire at the machines while navigating through their attacks, using health, shield, and weapon pickups to strengthen the ship during the fight. Different drone types keep the battlefield changing. Watch your health and protective shield as you continue the space battle against the invading forces.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Place your symbol and work toward a winning line in Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer. Tap a cell to make a move, watching both your own opportunities and the opponent's next threat. The game offers a multiplayer mode, a computer opponent, and a same-device option for playing with a friend. Choose how to play, then take turns trying to complete a line while blocking the other side.

pages.title: Mafia Poker
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete for the top place among rival crime families at the card table in Mafia Poker. The game uses Texas Hold'em, combining your private cards with the shared cards on the table to form a strong poker hand. Decide when to continue betting and when to fold as the cards develop. The mafia theme frames a contest settled through hands and chips.

pages.title: Animals Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture theme and find the pairs in Animals Memory. Click two face-down cards to reveal their images, keeping matching pairs uncovered and remembering the positions of different pictures when they turn back over. Correct matches add points, while incorrect pairs can cost points. An elapsed-time display tracks the attempt as you work through all the pairs on the board.

pages.title: Magic Discs Puzzle
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Rotate three numbered discs into a balanced arrangement in Magic Discs Puzzle. Every column must add up to the same total, but the game does not tell you that target number in advance. Compare the sums as you change the discs' positions and look for an arrangement that makes them equal. Solve all three levels to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Rat Arena
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Challenge a computer-controlled rat in Rat Arena. Move around the platform arena, jump between positions, and use weapons such as a sword, bow, or magic wand to fight the rival. A shield adds a defensive option, and the game offers different AI difficulty settings. Use A and D to move and W to jump, balancing your position with opportunities to attack and block.

pages.title: The Lost Planet Tower Defense
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description:
Protect a stranded spaceman in The Lost Planet Tower Defense. After a spacecraft crash-lands on an unfamiliar planet, its pilot must collect the scattered debris while surviving attacks from local monsters. Build defensive towers and improve them to hold off the attackers as you work toward gathering the pieces.

Skills and upgrades help develop your defenses, while energy and tower costs make construction a resource decision. Choose which improvements to make before the next battle and keep strengthening the defenses needed to survive the lost planet.

pages.title: Popular Cheer Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Prepare Lisa for cheerleading tryouts in Popular Cheer Hairstyles. Start by washing her hair, applying a hair mask, and drying it before the styling begins. Choose a ponytail, a poof updo, or curls, then follow the game's steps to create that hairstyle.

Once her hair is ready, move on to the outfit. Pick a top and a matching bottom to put together the sporty look she will wear for the tryouts. The makeover combines guided hair care with the final clothing choices.

pages.title: Fashion EMO Girl
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Dress Elsa in an emo-inspired look in Fashion EMO Girl. Choose clothing combinations from the available options, trying different pieces to shape her outfit. The activity focuses on her wardrobe and the emo fashion theme, leaving you to decide which combination she should wear for her finished look.

pages.title: Pizza Realife Cooking
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Prepare and decorate your own pizza in Pizza Realife Cooking. Chop the ingredients and separate them into bowls, then arrange the toppings wherever you want on the pizza to create a design. Cook it and finish the meal with cheese or fresh salad. The activity follows the recipe from ingredient preparation through the final presentation, with room to choose how the toppings are arranged.

pages.title: Math Balls
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Clear numbered balls by making the requested sum in Math Balls. Click a selection whose values add up to the displayed target; a correct combination disappears and earns points, creating room for incoming balls. Combinations using more balls can produce special balls that help clear the pile. When the stack reaches the upper boundary, a countdown begins, so clear space before that warning turns into the end of the round.

pages.title: Princess House Hold Chores
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help a princess work through the jobs at home in Princess House Hold Chores. Begin by cleaning her room, then move on to washing dishes and ironing the royal clothes. The game guides you through each task and shows how to use the tools involved. Follow the steps to finish one chore before continuing with the next part of the household work.

pages.title: Rosanna Pansino Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Choose an outfit for a baking-show host in Rosanna Pansino Dress Up. Help the game's version of Rosanna prepare for another episode by selecting clothing and accessories that fit the recipe of the day. Try different combinations as you put together her on-screen appearance. The baking-show setting gives the styling task its theme while you decide what she should wear.

pages.title: Ice Princess Make Up Academy
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Begin a makeover-school session in Ice Princess Make Up Academy. Prepare the model at the spa by washing, exfoliating, and moisturizing her face, then choose the makeup colors and styles for her look. After the cosmetics are finished, browse the wardrobe for blouses, skirts, jewelry, and accessories. Match the clothing to the makeup you created to complete the academy makeover.

pages.title: FGP Bubbleshooter
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Aim for matching colors and clear the field in FGP Bubbleshooter. Launch a bubble into a group of the same color, connecting at least three to make them pop. Each successful group earns points and removes bubbles from the arrangement. Study where the next shot will land and keep working through the clusters until no bubbles remain on the board.

pages.title: Princesses Masterchef Contestants
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Prepare Anna and Elsa for a televised cooking competition in Princesses Masterchef Contestants. First help the two princesses choose the outfits they will wear as contestants. Then arrange dishes on a table for the presentation stage. Their clothing and food displays are both part of the judging, so give each character a coordinated appearance and a carefully prepared table before comparing the results.

pages.title: Barbie Coachella
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create a festival makeover for Barbie in Barbie Coachella. Start with eyeshadow, mascara, and lipstick, then explore a wardrobe of tops, fringed shorts, bohemian skirts, jackets, and cardigans. Accessories such as oversized necklaces and flower headbands help finish the look. Mix the pieces into different outfits so Barbie has several music-festival combinations to choose from.

pages.title: Dove Prom Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Help Dove get ready for prom in Dove Prom Dolly Dress Up H5. Choose a dress and coordinate it with earrings, a purse, and shoes to build her evening outfit. Try the available combinations until the pieces work together, then save a picture for the prom album. The activity centers on assembling Dove's finished look for her night out.
